The '''Ezran system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] used by Republic-aligned [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] was discovered in the Ezran system. The elite [[Empire's Fury]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] then [[Battle of the Ezran system|destroyed the outpost]].<ref name="Ezran Outpost">{{TORcite|type=space|Ezran Outpost}}</ref>
